nodes.claim: The perfect combination is one joint hierarchical person-model published as an auditable coordinate system rather than embodied in any single engine: a between-person geometry every axiom measures into, plus within-person state geometries with their own estimated loadings — linked in one model, never conflated — published at model level with aggregate sufficient statistics, never as a table of person scores.
nodes.detail: Revised 2026-08-28 to resolve the program's first contradicts edge (tst-6→cen-1, landed 2026-08-27, scoped to the 2026-08-26 form's singular 'one published coordinate system'); re-read 2026-09-02 against its rewritten neighbours (go-12). The fork is accepted rather than argued down: the singular assumed ergodicity silently, and three lanes reached it from three sides on one fact base (tst-7, cited: between-person structure generalizes within persons only under rarely-met ergodicity; within-person variance runs 2–4× group estimates; factor scores are indeterminate, plausible values the remedy) — tst-6 (argued) composing the architecture; pat-9 and pat-10 (cited, fissioned from pat-3 on 2026-09-01, where this node's attribution had been stranded) adding the estimator-level evidence that conflation is an estimator property and the native machinery separates three coupling structures, not two, pat-3 keeping the estimand thesis; map-6 (argued since its 09-01 fission, the level-divergence evidence at map-7, cited) carrying the display consequence. Surviving from the 08-26 form: coordinate-system-not-engine (pat-2, pat-7); each axiom entering through its own measurement model onto the shared between-person space (tst-3's link families, que-2's item parameters, banded bio imports gen-2/gen-8, sensor bands bod-2); engine choice as empirical measurement (pat-6 — D325 shipped the prequential instrument). What the revision adds: (1) the joint model is hierarchical — between-person coordinates for crowd couplings, within-person state spaces with their own loadings where occasions exist (pat-8), cross-level loading invariance tested, never assumed (tst-6); (2) publication is settled at model level — population-level sufficient statistics reproducing couplings with uncertainty, never per-person latent draws — which is db-6's join currency reached from the database side; the published within-person object is population-average (pat-3). The 08-26 form's second risk — instrument space and combination space not one object — was answered by tst-6 as embedding, not exhaustion: the tests space is a proper subspace, the rest identified by the other axioms' measurement models (que-5 agrees). Edge accounting 2026-09-02: cen-1→tst-1 retyped supports→refines — tst-1 (argued 09-01) is argument for this node, and this node places tst-1's one instrument model as an embedded subspace of the joint model, which is refinement, not a second support; the same-type cycle go-12 flagged is closed. Named risk retained: distillation faithfulness above pat-6's crossover is unmeasured (pat-7). The pairwise-tables alternative still fails on the population leg, now more sharply: an unpaired pair is set-valued, not tabulable (pat-4, cited). To cited: multi-battery latent modeling, IRT linking, multilevel SEM (carried at tst-7). To measured: fit the between layer against the score shelf; the within layer waits on repeated measurements (the era question is needs-owner at the bridge).

nodes.claim: An axiom's value is its marginal information about the rest, measured in two components — crowd value as marginal prequential surprisal reduction on a common population, identified only against axes it is jointly observed with and set-valued elsewhere, and personal-lens value bounded by the person's own occasions — never by novelty or effort.
nodes.detail: Restated 2026-08-28 (the ranking moved to cen-8); revised 2026-09-02 on pat-4's rise to cited. THE METRIC: an axiom's crowd value is the drop in held-out one-step-ahead predictive log-loss (surprisal bits) on the other axioms' observations when its columns enter the conditioning set, evaluated on a COMMON population — the whole answered stream under the joint model's explicit missingness — never on per-pair intersections (cen-1's rejected incoherence at portfolio level). The yardstick is pat-6's prequential family; its baseline term ships (D325), and the path to measured runs through the main-readable scorecard (map's request, ruled 08-28). PAIRING, corrected: the 08-28 form said pairing governs precision, not definition — thin pairing widens error bars, it does not zero value. pat-4 (cited 09-02, the data-combination literature) shows that holds only above zero: two axes never observed jointly on the same people pin their coupling to a conditional Fréchet set under the declared conditioning covariates (pat-4's X, the block answered by everyone — not the D8 anchor snapshot), which no crowd size narrows except by making a finer conditioning set estimable (pat-4's own carve-out) — so an axiom's marginal term against an axis it shares no person with is an interval, not a small number, and its crowd value is defined only over the set of axes it is co-observed with; the first paired person buys identification, every later one precision. The claim string carries that boundary; pattern's prose contradiction (go-6) is resolved by target revision. pat-12 (cited) adds the constructive half: pairing is a design variable — one more paired person's marginal value on a declared target coupling is expected information per cost, this metric supplying the target, and co-service on the spine is what buys a model-free coupling. BUDGET (pat-8, cited): two dimensions — crowd value funded by persons, personal-lens value by that person's own occasions, since N/T compensation holds for population estimands and fails structurally for person-specific ones — so personal value is bounded by an axis's own repeat cadence; a genotype is a constant with no within-person half (map-7's scope note, re-pointed from map-6 after the 09-01 fission); body channels repeat by nature (pat-8's term); bod-5 supplies the one measured ordering, scoped to sleep since its 08-29 re-scope, with its overlapping CIs travelling with it (re-read 09-02). cen-10 adds a third dimension, ties. ONE CURRENCY (que-8, argued on que-7 cited; carried 09-01): comparability is a graded validity floor outside the currency, slots above it priced in program-horizon prequential bits, this lane's discount rate the reduced form with even its sign empirical; limits carried — independence approximation, local linearisation, que-3's warmth guardrail — and horizon, weighting and required rungs are owner inputs. To cited: marginal-predictive-value ranking, prequential evaluation.

nodes.claim: A new-axiom candidate is admitted by a five-part argument — the residual variance it would explain, the budget dimension that funds it, its custody tier, its entry mode, and its direct-output anchors — applied in expectation until the joint model's residuals exist, then re-derived against them.
nodes.detail: Raised conjecture→argued 2026-09-01, and fissioned the same run per go-7 (the 2026-08-25 seed carried criterion and candidate list under one status; the list now lives at cen-9, this lane's cen-2/cen-8 split repeated). The seed's criterion — candidates surface where the joint model's residuals cluster — is right but idle until the joint model exists; this revision replaces waiting with the combination's own admission test, applied in expectation now and re-derivable against actual residuals later (the seed's criterion survives as that eventual replacement). The test composes five sibling results. VALUE: cen-2's metric in expectation — a candidate names whose observations it would reduce surprisal on AND on whom it would be co-observed, since (pat-4, carried into cen-2 on 2026-09-02) a candidate jointly observed with no axis has a set-valued value, not a small one — or stays off the list. FUNDING: pat-8's two dimensions — a candidate whose claimed value is within-person must name a real occasions source — one the axis produces by its nature, shipped or not — or the claim is unfunded; a crowd-value claim is priced by pairing — and, since cen-10 (2026-09-02), a candidate whose unit is a tie must name the ties that fund its person-level readings, the third resource. CUSTODY: cen-6's tier declaration, made at admission rather than retrofitted. ENTRY MODE: the genetic lane's import principle generalized (gen-1/gen-8) — where a consented artifact already exists in people's hands, importing beats building collection. ANCHORS: gen-10's lesson transposed — gen-10's own cited claim is scoped to genotypes and single-protein direct-output phenotypes; the generalization to any new axis (a small enumerable set of items where the axis predicts an individual answer multiplies calibration value, and its absence is itself admissible information) is this lane's transposition, marked as such per cen-7's own precedent. The seed's rule survives sharpened: candidates enter and leave with arguments, not fashion — one naming no residual, or claiming within-person value with no occasions source, is off the list. Boundary against §1, drawn after this run's adversarial pass: the test's terms are principled, not practical — funding names what the axis can produce in principle, custody and entry mode are design-quality grounds (gen-1's shape: fewer custody surfaces is better design, not cheaper engineering) — and where already-shipped data is mentioned at cen-9 it is a tiebreaker outside the theory, labeled as such, never a ranking ground. Re-read 2026-09-02 against cen-2's revision and extended at FUNDING for cen-10's third resource; custody, entry mode and anchors stand as written. The test is expectation-grade: it ranks arguments, not measurements, and every slot it fills names the instrument that would test it (cen-9 per candidate).

nodes.claim: Under the admission test the current candidate list orders: time-use/chronotype first, microbiome behind the import door, voice held at the instrument gate, place history last — social-graph texture left the list with the 2026-09-01 chartering of the ties axis.
nodes.detail: Fissioned out of cen-3 2026-09-01; re-derived 2026-09-02 after the owner chartered the ties lane (2026-09-01, 'Ties and Interests are chartered' on main; recorded here a day later). GRADUATED: social-graph texture, second on the 09-01 list, is now the chartered ties axiom. Against cen-3's five parts after the fact: three pass, two stay open. VALUE: relational variance no self-report reaches — tie-3's separation of reading from projection and tie-4's nominations as sociometry, the lane's own arguments (tie-5's phrasing restates this node's 09-01 text and is not cited back) — reducing surprisal on the answer stream's own items and co-observed by construction, every duel player being on the stream. FUNDING: cen-10's third resource, carried into cen-3 this run. CUSTODY: the published tier already — duel reveals are public under D98; the follow graph is world-readable under D101, a judgement call the rules record as NOT a consequence of D98. ENTRY: open — the record is operator-held, not gen-8's artifact in people's hands, which is exactly the already-shipped data cen-3 confines to a tiebreaker. ANCHORS: the weakest — tie-2's keyed guess is the axis's own observation, not an external item set where a tie reading predicts an individual answer; the analogy to gen-10 does not close here. Its dyadic-consent note (gen-6 transposed) is now tie-5's own. (1) TIME-USE/CHRONOTYPE first: no new consent or custody surface — answering-time phase and regularity are properties of timestamps on answers the person already publishes, so it enters at cen-6's published tier with zero new collection (gen-1's custody-quality argument in time-use form); occasions-funded in principle, answering itself being the occasion stream pat-8 says person-specific estimands need; that the product records the timestamps is the tiebreaker. It deepens bod-5's sleep-percept channel, and chronotype's genetic cross is architecture-level (gen-9-shaped, not an anchor). Honesty notes: app-use timing measures the app-use channel, not sleep (bod-3 transposed); and the binding confound — answering phase is chronotype convolved with the product's delivery schedule (UTC boundary, reveal cycles, pushes) — must be broken out first, or the cheap test is not cheap. (2) MICROBIOME: enters only through gen-8's import door generalized — consumer reports some people already hold, a state measurement like methylation. Custody premise expectation-grade: 16S-class summaries and host-genotype-bearing shotgun files are different classes, and gen-8's recoverability evidence is methylation arrays — so gen-8's full custody carryover is the conservative default, not a fact. No microbiome–trait coupling is cited. (3) VOICE: held at the gate — a within-person affect channel, exactly where bod-7 bites (attenuated-or-unmeasured until construct validity is shown); raw voice is maximally identifying, so only edge-derived features could cross (bod-2). (4) PLACE HISTORY last: it abuts the physical-safety deny; coarse derived classes (climate, urbanicity, mobility regularity) differ from live presence — an owner question under D334, the deny itself outside the ask — but its custody argument is the hardest and nothing else needs it settled. Reordering evidence: a real residual analysis (cen-3's eventual test), a construct-validity result for voice, or answer-timing regularity carrying no trait signal once the schedule convolution is removed.

nodes.claim: Outside-axiom entries are first-class: a person may cross one axiom against the rest without that axiom ever joining any crowd.
nodes.detail: The owner's example: enter your DNA and see how it interacts with your other data — personally, without contributing to any aggregate. In the joint-model frame this is well-defined (condition YOUR person-model on the extra columns; publish nothing), and it matters for the portfolio: an axiom can be valuable at population zero, purely as a personal lens. It also cleanly separates two consents (use for me vs contribute to the crowd) that most systems conflate. Re-read 2026-09-02 against cen-1's hierarchical form (go-12): the entry stays well-defined and gains a level — a constant column (a genotype) conditions the person's between-person coordinates and has no within-person half; a personal series (methylation files, gen-8; sensor bands, bod-2) conditions the person's own within-person geometry — and in both cases nothing is published. The interests seed supplies the second live example beside the owner's: D163's device-held behavioural model is, in int-1's reading, a personal lens at population zero — the richest of the three interest implementations and never pooled. One bound sharpened by the custody lanes: where the datum is about more than one person — kin (gen-6), a chosen tie (tie-5) — 'use for me' still needs the other party's consent, so an outside-axiom entry is a one-person act only for one-person data.

nodes.claim: The research ambition — contributions to areas like aging — runs through published, provenance-carrying couplings over consented aggregates, and through nothing else.
nodes.detail: The perfect combination is a research instrument to the exact extent its outputs are reproducible by outsiders: couplings published with n, method, sampling model (pat-5) and provenance, over consented data, at aggregate grain. That is what a real research field can cite and check. The alternative ambitions (private discovery claims, individual-level readouts) fail §9 or fail science, usually both. gen-4 carries the aging-specific half.

nodes.claim: The combination's custody law: raw stays where the person is, what crosses into shared computation is derived and carries its basis, and what is published is recomputable — the excluded architecture is pooled raw under operator custody.
nodes.detail: Added 2026-08-26, adversarially narrowed the same run (the first form's 'exactly two grains' contradicted cen-1's joint computation and the product's per-person derived state); re-read 2026-09-02 (go-12). The lanes converge on a custody SHAPE: three roles a datum can occupy, each with its own grain. (1) PERSONAL: raw, full-resolution, in the person's own custody, publishing nothing — cen-4's outside-axiom entry generalized to every axiom; the interests axis's device-held behavioural model (int-1, argued) is the shipped instance. (2) SHARED COMPUTATION: what crosses into any pooled computation is derived, not raw — banded scores (gen-2), edge-folded bands (bod-2), values-with-provenance rather than artifacts (bod-4) — and carries its basis. db-6's 2026-09-02 rise to cited sharpens this tier twice (depends edge added 09-02; db-6 built on this node, so it is leaned on for evidence, never counted as confirmation): the cross-axis statistic is computed JOINTLY — within a person by their own custody, across custodians by secure computation — never by physically pooling two custody classes; and 'derived' is not automatically safe (allele frequencies, gradients and too many exact aggregates all reconstruct), so what leaves this tier passes disclosure control first. (3) PUBLISHED: aggregate and recomputable by a reader from public numbers (pat-2), drawable on the device from published bins over a declared plane (map-5, restated 09-02 to bounded per-view work rather than none — the property borrowed here, published aggregates never per-person rows, stands). The exclusion is carried by the custody lanes: pooled RAW under operator custody is what gen-2 (a genome is unrevocable and familial), gen-6 (kinship consent) and bod-2 (maximal re-identification surface at near-zero coupling value) each rule out on their own grounds; pat-2 and map-5 contribute the published tier's shape only. Not forbidden: shared computation over consented observation streams at native grain (InSight's answers are public by the product's consent model, D98) and per-person DERIVED state under operator custody with declared access — 'derived, with its basis' is the line, not 'nothing pooled'. The law hands the bridge a test: name your tier; a request that moves raw across custody is malformed — and, since db-6, so is one that recomposes a cross-axis number from per-axis marginals. Lane-side grounding: db-2 (cited: custody-as-layout in i2b2, All of Us, MIMIC-IV) for layout; db-7 (cited) for erasure as a transaction. Open, named by db-6 and not yet carried here: tier (3)'s 'recomputable from public numbers' spends a disclosure budget the reconstruction law makes finite. This node's own rise waits on sources in its own list; 'industry default' stays unasserted. To cited: local-first computation, federated analytics, edge-computation privacy.

nodes.claim: Every published cross-axiom coupling is a declared object — its level, its population and basis, its decomposition, its instrument-validity status, its sampling design and its as-of pin travel with the number — and this grammar is constitutive of the combination's value, not packaging around it.
nodes.detail: Added 2026-08-28; refined 2026-09-02 with a sixth clause, and its edges re-read against four rewritten targets (go-12). The convergence is not independent and saying so is the honest version: SUBJECT lanes derived their clauses from their own evidence; READER lanes composed theirs partly by synthesis, db-6 building on cen-6, so db-6 is not cited back as confirmation; the COMPOSITION is this lane's. The clauses: gen-11 (cited) — a gene–trait coupling publishes its direct/genetic-nurture/mating-structure decomposition, never the bare correlation; bod-6/bod-7/bod-8 (cited) — effect-size currency declared, instrument status three-valued (measured/attenuated/unmeasured), and decomposition STATUS with unknowns and unsearched limbs declared, bod-8's honest form since even design-based decomposition disagrees with itself; tst-6 (on tst-7 cited) — couplings computed through the model, published as aggregate sufficient statistics; pat-3 (cited) — artifacts level-labeled, pat-10 supplying the label set, the published within-person object population-average; pat-5 — a sampling model beside every coupling; db-6 (cited 09-02) — the join's currency is (statistic, basis n, provenance, reference basis, version), plus a publication condition beside the declarations: the number has passed disclosure control; db-8 (cited 09-02) — the sampling design travels as recorded propensities OR as covariates rich enough to render selection ignorable, and the declaration names which; db-9 (cited 09-02), the sixth clause — a published number carries the ledger position it was folded through, its as-of pin, and says whether it is 'as published' or 'as best known'; map-6 (argued since its 09-01 fission) — the drawn connection carries population, decomposition and basis in the frame by form, on map-7's cited divergence and map-10's standing negative that no study shows readers recover an undeclared population unaided; que-4 (cited) — cross-cohort comparison graded by a named invariance method, labeled with its basis. Justification: what each missing clause costs, per the lanes' own evidence — drop the decomposition and a composite masquerades as a mechanism (gen-11); drop instrument status and an unmeasured channel masquerades as a small coupling (bod-7); drop the sampling design and a serving-policy artifact masquerades as a population fact (pat-5, db-8); drop the level and three objects collapse into one wrong number (pat-3); drop the pin and the number cannot be reproduced against the ledger that made it (db-9). cen-6 is WHAT may cross a boundary; this is what a crossing MEANS; db-6 composes both. Load-bearing for cen-5: a field cites only what carries its interpretation conditions. Status argued deliberately: no external source asserts the composed grammar. To cited: reporting-standards precedent (GRADE at go-1; STROBE-class statements).

nodes.claim: Current portfolio ranking, argued not measured: questions first; tests and ties second on keyed-channel grounds — logic's ability channel and the duel's second-person channel, neither recoverable from the opinion stream — plus interpretability, ties' rank provisional on its seed's first cited rise; then body, genetic and interests, unordered and split by funding dimension (occasions- or pairing-funded) rather than ranked — each slot carrying the evidence that would demote it.
nodes.detail: Fissioned out of cen-2 2026-08-28; body slot bounded 09-01; ties and interests placed 2026-09-02. (1) QUESTIONS dominate: the answer stream is the common conditioning set whose removal collapses every other axiom's identification — and, since pat-12, the everyone-block whose CO-SERVICE is what buys a model-free tail–tail coupling (pat-4 having shown that conditioning on the block alone leaves the coupling set-valued) — and the phenotype battery is the scarce asset whose factory the questions axiom is (gen-3, cited); que-5 bends the spine toward joint-space identification; gen-10 (cited) makes genetic tractability a spine-composition property. (2) TESTS and TIES second, together, on the one ground that survives cen-2's metric — a keyed channel not recoverable from the opinion stream: logic items are a new ability channel (tst-3), and the duel guess is a second-person measurement graded against a key (tie-2, argued) whose readings — accuracy against projection (tie-3), legibility, nomination-based reputation (tie-4) — no self-report item reaches. The keys differ in kind — logic's is objective, the duel's is the target's own self-position, so the second-person reading is bounded by the target's instrument and tst-3's split does not transfer unmodified; the shared property is only non-recoverability. Tests add interpretability (the joint space's coordinates, tst-1); ties add relational variance on chosen ties, and are priced in cen-2's own currency through homophily (tie-5): conditioning on whom a person follows reduces surprisal on that person's own answers, testable from public data. Ties' rank is PROVISIONAL (a one-day-old lane, nothing above argued), funded by cen-10's third count. Neither slot coasts: instrument-score columns derived from already-conditioned answers add roughly zero marginal bits (tst-2's passive administration is pairing coverage), and ties' collection being shipped (with zero plays recorded at the 08-27 scorecard) is a labeled tiebreaker, not the ground. (3) BODY, GENETIC and INTERESTS split by funding dimension, not ranked: body's value concentrates in the within-person channel occasions fund (bod-5, cited: sleep→self-control within larger than between at the point estimates, CIs overlapping) — narrowed 09-01 by bod-9/bod-10 to channels with reliable state instruments, sleep first, the affect channel being the perception channel the pulse collects (bod-11); genetic's is pairing-funded — option value rising with paired population (gen-3), enumerable direct-output anchors (gen-10), constant-column personal conditioning (cen-4) — with no within-person half; interests' is pairing-funded option value beside genetic (int-3 on gen-3: no GWAS of an administered inventory exists) plus, if int-5 (a conjecture with empty detail) survives, the one axis with native occasions — gated, because the inventory-grade measurement does not exist on the answer stream (int-2; the bridge's 08-28 not-yet). FALSIFIERS per slot: a bio axis whose banded columns fail to reduce answer-side surprisal at grown pairing demotes; body's occasions argument weakens if within-person sleep couplings fail on the pulse-repeat artifact, and its affect half demotes to unmeasured if bod-11's common-method rival explains the percept→affect couplings; tests falls to interpretability alone if logic's channel proves recoverable from the opinion stream; ties collapses into a lens on tests if perceiver variance dominates and relationship variance is negligible (tie-1's own falsifier); interests' slot is redundant collection if declared choices predict the other axioms as well as an inventory would (int-1's).

nodes.claim: The combination's information budget is two-dimensional at each unit, and the relational axiom introduces a second unit — the tie — so the portfolio's bookkeeping needs a third count, a person's ties, that no count of persons and no count of one person's days supplies: a pair's days fund the within-tie reading, a person's tie count funds the person-level second-person readings, and every axiom is placed by which resource funds its distinctive value.
nodes.detail: Added 2026-09-02. tie-2 (argued) states the observation — ties are a third resource neither of pat-8's dimensions names; this node supplies the orthogonality argument and the portfolio consequence, on pat-8/pat-12 (cited) and tie-1/tie-2. pat-8 established that the budget has two dimensions — persons fund population estimands, a person's own occasions fund person-specific ones — and that they substitute only for population-level estimands. The relational axiom's unit is a tie, not a person (tie-1): its record is keyed by a pair or group and a day, and its readings decompose, in Kenny's design tie-2 names, into perceiver, target and relationship components that need each person to appear in SEVERAL dyads. So the resource that funds a tie-level reading is neither dimension: a pair with many days funds the within-tie estimand (this pair's steadiness) but not a person-level perceiver effect; a person with many one-day ties funds the perceiver and target effects but no within-tie dynamics. That is pat-8's substitution failure one level up — person-level components are population-average estimands over a person's ties, the relationship effect is pair-specific and bounded by the pair's own days — with the level tie-1 names beside pat-10's three networks: between-tie, within-tie-over-days, person-across-ties. Hence a third COUNT, orthogonal by the same argument that separates the first two: no count of persons, and no count of one person's days, supplies ties. Stated at its true strength after this run's adversarial pass: the person-level tie components behave like pat-8's persons dimension re-indexed to the dyad, so what is new is a second UNIT with its own two dimensions, not a third axis of the same space — the claim is bookkeeping, and the edge to pat-8 is typed refines for that reason (tie-2 elected the same type). Consequences for the combination, this lane's: (i) an axiom is placed in the portfolio by which resource funds its DISTINCTIVE value — the component that would not exist without it, since cen-2 gives every axiom two components (cen-8) — persons (genetic, interests-as-inventory), occasions (body, time-use), ties (the relational axiom, alone); (ii) cen-2's pairing arithmetic counts PAIRS for a tie-unit axis — the paired population of ties, never larger than the number of ties, is what identifies a relational coupling (pat-4 transposed), and its personal-lens value is funded by that person's own ties; (iii) pat-12 transposed: who duels whom is a design variable — the round-robin or block design the decomposition needs is planned missingness on the tie matrix. Falsifiers: tie-1's own — if relationship variance is negligible the tie collapses to the person and this dimension to the first; or a demonstration that a person's components are estimable from days within the same few ties (days substituting for ties), which would make the dimension a product of the other two, not a third. Status argued: a composition of sibling results with no source of its own; to cited, the SRM's design-requirement literature and the N/T substitution results at pat-8.
